title: OpenAPI 3.1 Specification and RFC 9457 Error Handling Standards
acceptance_criteria: Valid OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 YAML specification covering minimum 10 endpoints in docs/Ediens_OpenAPI.yaml.
Full RFC 9457 ProblemDetails error schemas defined with custom errorCode and extensions.
Concrete request and response payload examples for HTTP 400, 403, 404, 409, 422, and 429 across the endpoints.
Comprehensive Client Reaction Rules matrix in 05-error-handling.md specifying how React frontend reacts to each error code.
